title: Telephone scam detection demo
intro: Try the detectors from the paper on a call of your own, run the paper's two tests on a small sample, and look at the results reported in the paper.

examples.label: Example: technical-support scam
examples.text:
Caller: Hello, this is the Windows technical department. We have detected a virus on your computer that is sending your bank details to hackers.
Customer: Oh no, what should I do?
Caller: Please do not turn the computer off. Go to your browser and download AnyDesk so I can remove the virus for you.
Customer: Okay, it is downloading.
Caller: Good. The repair costs 299 dollars. You can pay with Google Play gift cards from any shop. Please stay on the line and do not tell anyone at the bank, they may be involved.

examples.label: Example: legitimate appointment call
examples.text:
Caller: Hi, this is Sarah from Riverside Dental. I am calling to remind you about your check-up with Dr Patel tomorrow at 10:30.
Customer: Oh, thanks for calling. Could we move it to later in the week? Something has come up at work.
Caller: Of course. We have Thursday at 2 pm or Friday at 9 am.
Customer: Thursday at 2 works for me.
Caller: Great, I have moved you to Thursday at 2 pm. See you then.
Customer: Thank you, bye.

examples.label: Example: delivery call
examples.text:
Caller: Hi, this is the courier. I have a parcel for you, but nobody answered the door.
Customer: Sorry, I am at work. Can you leave it with the neighbour at number 12?
Caller: Sure, I will leave it with them and put a card in your letterbox.
Customer: Great, thanks.
Caller: No problem, have a good day.

reproduce: Download the code, install Python 3.10 to 3.12 and Ollama, then run: pip install -r requirements.txt and ollama pull qwen2.5:14b. One GPU with 12 GB of memory is enough.
The datasets are in the datasets folder of the code.
The README gives one command for each table. Each command prints the values of its table and saves the answer for every call.

Compare the values and the answers with the paper. The LLM runs at temperature 0 and BERT with a fixed seed, so they should match, apart from small differences that other GPUs or software versions can cause.
